claim.purpose: Preserve complete ADL CSM coverage while partitioning Runtime v3 selectors

initial.title: [v0.91.7][tooling][coverage] Preserve the complete ADL CSM suite in Runtime v3 bridge coverage
initial.goal: Make the bounded Runtime v3/CSM route pass the changed-source coverage gate without foreign selectors.
initial.required_outcome: The exact mixed expression runs the complete valid ADL CSM selector family plus the owning Runtime v3 tests and produces an 80-percent-or-better changed-source result.
authority_boundary: Issue #5514 owns only completeness of the #5512 workspace partition
Issue #5494 owns Runtime v3 and CSM implementation
initial.task_boundary: Restore all valid ADL CSM selectors in the exact bridge partition without changing runtime behavior, coverage thresholds, Runtime v2, or AWS lanes.
deliverables: Regression assertion for every retained ADL selector
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Exact canonical-expression matching remains fail closed
AC-2: Every valid ADL CSM selector in the canonical expression reaches the ADL workspace
AC-3: Runtime v3 auth, supervision, and topology selectors reach only adl-runtime
AC-4: The nonexistent adl::cli_smoke selector and Runtime v2 remain absent
AC-5: The #5504 changed-source coverage gate passes without lowering thresholds
initial.plan_summary: Retain exact-expression routing, expand the ADL partition to the complete valid CSM family, lock the command contract, and rerun #5504 CI.

steps.action: Expand the exact bridge ADL partition to every valid owning selector
Strengthen the command-level regression contract and validate locally
Review, merge, rebase #5504, and prove the changed-source gate

risks: A retained selector could still name the wrong binary
A weak test could verify only parse success rather than suite completeness
A broad detector could alter unrelated expressions
invariants: Only the exact canonical mixed expression is specialized
Each workspace receives only tests it owns
Runtime v2 and AWS remain outside scope
stop_conditions: The repair requires production runtime changes
The repair requires Runtime v2 changes
review_prompts: Does the ADL partition preserve every valid selector from the canonical expression?
Can a foreign selector reach either workspace?
Does exact matching still reject near matches?
Does the regression prove command completeness and summary composition?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove complete workspace partitioning and exact command construction

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if any canonical ADL CSM selector is discarded, any foreign selector reaches an owning workspace, exact matching weakens, thresholds change, or Runtime v2/AWS enters scope.
